req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The violations are: test[3] has kind=negative but heuristic=EP (rule: negative kind requires NEG heuristic or BVA, not EP), and test[4] has kind=negative but heuristic=BVA (rule: negative kind must use NEG heuristic, not BVA). Fix: change test[3] heuristic from EP to NEG (it is a negative test sampling the invalid equivalence partition, which is correctly described by NEG), and change test[4] heuristic from BVA to NEG (limit=0 is a negative/invalid input test, not a boundary acceptance test). All other tests are preserved exactly.

tests.name: test_limit_at_maximum_cap_returns_200
expected: Response body is a JSON list
trace: R-TASK-007: limit=1000 is exactly at the cap (le=1000), must be accepted
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_at_maximum_cap_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1000')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_limit_at_maximum_cap_returns_200()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_large_value_returns_422():
    r = client.get('/tasks/?limit=9999')
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    errors = body['detail']
    assert isinstance(errors, list)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    locs = [e.get('loc', []) for e in errors]
    assert any('limit' in loc for loc in locs)

test_limit_large_value_returns_422()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_default_no_param_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20
